ANATOMICAL LEFT arm continuously cradles exactly one little white fox against left ribs, left hand supports it. ANATOMICAL RIGHT hand palm-up continuously supports the same small blue snowflake crystal. Exactly two arms, two hands and two legs total, no unused extra arms. Preserve hands and props on their own sides; natural shoulder/elbow motion even while holding props.
POSE 03 LEFT leg compressed at lowest stance under hip, RIGHT folded knee passes beside support knee without crossing legs. RIGHT shoulder returns toward neutral, palm/crystal by waist.
The legs must create a fast running stride with genuine forward travel, torso leans slightly forward, not walking and not a standing display of the crystal. Natural perspective foreshortening; feet stay aligned with the running direction, clear left/right support and swing. Robe follows hips and exposes the two knees/boots enough to read motion. Continuous small fox bob, robe/tassel follow-through.

Leave all ears, sleeves, crystal, boots and tassels safely inside canvas with clear margin. DO NOT zoom, enlarge head or crop, no ground shadow or backdrop. Clean bright rounded high-end Chinese Daoist chibi hand-painted look matching supplied identity and approved style. True RGBA transparency. No text, no particles, no motion blur, no duplicates or ghosts.
Ground-contact constraint: this is a ONE-LEG SUPPORT pose. LEFT boot visibly contacts the virtual floor at 92% canvas height; supporting knee compresses, while the OTHER boot is lifted at least 8% canvas height above that floor.
